status: 32-person lightweight two-deck concept: two 8.5 m-floor discs at 0.25 g, filled to the hub; hardware targets, torpor and full-diet food factory unvalidated
preferred_arrival_architecture: Staged surface delivery: habitats and settlement equipment descend; cruise-only module remains in orbit.
landing_propulsion_selection: Hybrid candidate: direct antimatter orbital braking, then antimatter-heated hydrogen terminal descent; safe cutoff unresolved
landing_acceleration_policy: Size for braking needs subject to crew, structural and equipment limits; no 1.2g landing cap

geometry_study_not_selected_dimensions.interior_room_dimensions: Two decks per disc. Outer deck: four 4-berth bays and four two-cell shared rooms. Inner deck, up to the hub: four three-cell plant, garden, workshop and store rooms. About 375 m2 gross per disc.

operating_states: Expanded, locked habitat during powered flight with floors re-set across the thrust
Expanded, nonrotating surface settlement lying flat round a central hall, joined to two inflatable residences
not_yet_estimated: Validated fabric packing and deployment mechanisms
Pressure, creep, puncture, fire and structural qualification
Refuge endurance, medical recovery and crash-load certification
Access and floor conversion under thrust gravity

common_space_programme.normal_awake_shipwide: Exactly eight people in awake phase, with paired starts staggered every 42 hours; sleep and recovery watchkeeping still require qualification.
common_space_programme.flight_occupancy_policy: Eight awake and 24 torpid during departure, coast and arrival braking. All 32 awake for descent; retain 32 protected descent places. Transit common rooms are sized for eight, surface expansion supports 32.
common_space_programme.quiet_loud_separation: Berth bays alternate with shared rooms on the outer deck; plant, garden, workshop and stores fill the low-gravity inner deck.
common_space_programme.circulation: Each deck is a ring of four merged rooms (outer deck: four two-cell rooms between four berth bays). Rooms are walked through via doorways in bulkheads along a 1.2 m aisle; each shared room has a ladder to the deck above (inner deck to the hub). Egress and disability access require full human-factors review.
common_space_programme.lighting: Indirect circadian lighting, glare-controlled task lights and dimmable cabin lights
common_space_programme.privacy: Curtained two-tier berths in transit; private couple cabins are in the surface inflatables.
common_space_programme.air_quality: Dedicated ventilation diffusers, return grilles and washable surfaces; no crop CO2 enrichment in living areas

habitat_layout_revision: ISS-informed functional equipment and long-duration social-space proposal; not an as-built replica or certified pressure vessel
